test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
You are given a statement followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given assumptions can definitely be drawn from the given statement.

Statement:

Due to ongoing road work, all traffic on Road X is being diverted to the Airport Road.

Assumptions:

I. There is heavy traffic jam on the Airport Road.

II. Flights are being rescheduled because people are not able to reach the airport on time.

options.text: Both I and II are embedded.
Neither I nor II is embedded

solution:
Given Statement: Due to ongoing road work, all traffic on Road X is being diverted to the Airport Road.

Now, 

Assumptions:

1. There is heavy traffic jam on the Airport Road - Not Implicit (The statement does not provide enough information to conclude that there is a traffic jam on the Airport Road)

2. Flights are being rescheduled because people are not able to reach the airport on time - Not Implicit (The statement does not mention any information about flight schedules being affected)

Here, Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
